evals.name: design-retryable-export
evals.prompt: Add an API for starting customer exports. Exports can take minutes, users retry when mobile connections drop, and we need progress plus a downloadable result. Inspect the existing API conventions and tests, then propose or implement the safest contract.
evals.expected_output: Inspects repository conventions; chooses a durable operation/status resource; specifies idempotency, states, result retrieval, authorization, expiry, errors, and tests; avoids pretending the request is synchronous.
assertions: The response includes a decision brief or implementation plan grounded in existing files
The contract defines idempotency and a long-running operation lifecycle
The response includes validation for retries, authorization, failure, and old-client compatibility

evals.name: evolve-search-list
evals.prompt: Our existing /items endpoint needs filtering by owner, sorting by updated time, and pagination. Some clients are several releases behind. Design the change without breaking them.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the existing contract compatible where possible; defines stable ordering, bounded filters, opaque cursor behavior, limits, and a migration/deprecation plan; checks schemas and tests.
assertions: Pagination and ordering semantics are explicit
The answer addresses old clients and distinguishes additive from breaking changes
The answer does not impose a new API style without inspecting the existing endpoint

evals.name: ai-stream-and-webhook
evals.prompt: We are adding an AI job that streams tokens to a web client and sends a completion notification to another system. Decide whether to use SSE, polling, or webhooks and define the contracts.
evals.expected_output: Uses SSE for suitable one-way live updates and a webhook for cross-system notification, with reconnect/resumption, event IDs, deduplication, signing/authentication, retries, and reconciliation; calls out assumptions.
assertions: The choice is justified by client and delivery needs rather than ideology
SSE resumption and webhook at-least-once handling are specified
The answer includes failure and security-sensitive contract details without leaking secrets
